title: Exploring Vision Language Models for Facial Attribute Recognition: Emotion, Race, Gender, and Age

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores of Vision Language Models (VLMs) across different racial categories (e.g., White, Black, Indian, East Asian, Middle Eastern) using diverse facial image datasets like FairFace and UTKFace to identify predictive disparities.
Measuring classification performance metrics of VLMs across binary gender categories (Male, Female) using facial image datasets to assess demographic parity and predictive equality.
Assessing the recognition performance (accuracy, F1 scores) of VLMs across multiple distinct age group brackets to determine if the models generalize equally well for all ages.
